name: ehs-chemical-peers: a public-records peer explorer for US chemical manufacturing plants
description: A peer explorer for US chemical manufacturing plants (NAICS 325), built only from public records. It joins three government sources by address: OSHA injury logs, EPA chemical-release histories, and OSHA serious-injury reports. It does not audit any plant, it does not say why a plant's numbers are what they are, and it cannot see anything a plant did not report to the government.
